label: Street bollard
title: A narrow pause
text: Someone could pause beside the bollard to check a shopping list while other people pass between the stall and the street.

label: Canopy and supports
title: A change in the weather
text: A sudden shower could bring shoppers under the canopy. A dry display might briefly become a shared place to wait.

label: Hanging fruit
title: A question across the stall
text: A customer might point at a bunch of bananas and ask whether it will be ripe tomorrow. Choosing fruit can become a short conversation.

label: Fruit display
title: Choosing and rearranging
text: A shopper could turn a piece of fruit in their hand, while a worker quietly rearranges the display after each selection.

label: Display racks
title: The work behind the display
text: Before the stall opens, someone could carry, stack and steady these boxes. The arrangement that looks finished depends on repeated small tasks.

label: Alley plant
title: A small detour
text: A watering can might briefly share the passage with a delivery trolley. Two ordinary tasks could require a quick negotiation over space.

label: Upper window plant
title: Looking through
text: A passer-by could stop to look at the plant and notice their own reflection in the shop window.

label: Lower window plant
title: Care during a quiet moment
text: During a lull, someone might turn the pot towards the light. A tiny adjustment could be part of the work that keeps the frontage welcoming.

label: Right window plant
title: A familiar marker
text: A regular customer might use this plant as a meeting point: wait by the window, just past the fruit stall.

label: Climbing plants
title: Changing slowly
text: A new leaf could appear between two visits. The street changes on a different timescale from the daily movement of goods.

label: Right and middle buildings
title: One entrance, several needs
text: A delivery, a customer and a passer-by could reach the same entrance together. Who waits, and who has room to move?

label: Left wall and middle details
title: An everyday landmark
text: A small mark on a familiar wall might be enough for a worker to remember where a stack of boxes usually stops.

label: Pavement and drain
title: After the stall closes
text: An empty pavement could still carry traces of the day: a loose leaf, a damp patch, or the route taken by a trolley.
